question: What is the room rent limit and ICU sub-limit under the Arogya Sanjeevani policy?
expected_points: Room rent and boarding covered up to 2% of Sum Insured, maximum Rs. 5,000 per day; ICU/ICCU charges covered up to 5% of Sum Insured, maximum Rs. 10,000 per day
actual_answer: Under the Arogya Sanjeevani policy, room, boarding, and nursing expenses are covered up to 2% of the Sum Insured, subject to a strict maximum ceiling of Rs. 5,000 per day [1]. question: Can an insurance company deny a claim just because the hospital papers were submitted late?
expected_points: IRDAI prohibits rejecting claims solely due to delayed intimation or document submission if genuine emergency or hardship is established
actual_answer: Under IRDAI regulations, insurers and TPAs cannot repudiate or reject a claim solely on grounds of delay in claim intimation or delayed document submission, provided the claimant proves that the delay was due to genuine medical emergency or unavoidable hardship [2].
